scene_description: Wooden shelf top with curved wooden end panels against a gray wall. Two green cloth-covered boxes sit open side up, pushed back to the wall: the left one holds the white box top, the right one holds the open white box standing upright. Front is the open edge of the shelf.

targets.name: white box top
targets.description: White box top with blue handwritten 'HERBARIUM MICHAUX' on its front face, pushed into the front-right inner corner of the left green box.
targets.orientation: lying flat, closed top facing up
nearby_obstacles: Front wall of the left green box
Right wall of the left green box
targets.clearance_notes: Front and right faces sit flush against the green box walls; about 8 cm of open floor to its left and behind it.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the box top approximately 4 cm left, away from the right wall of the green box.
Slide the box top approximately 4 cm back, away from the front wall of the green box.

targets.other_notes: Distances come from the measured box sizes.

targets.name: white box
targets.description: Open white box with a tan insert on its floor, standing upright inside the right green box.
nearby_obstacles: Walls of the right green box around its base
targets.clearance_notes: Walls rise about 7 cm above the green box rim, so all sides and the top edge are exposed.

targets.name: left green box
targets.description: Green cloth-covered box with a white interior, open side up on the left side of the shelf, holding the white box top.
targets.clearance_notes: Front and sides are open, but it sits against the wall about 15 cm back from the shelf edge.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the green box approximately 10 cm toward the front of the shelf.

targets.other_notes: The box top inside is loose and will slide if tilted.

targets.name: right green box
targets.description: Green cloth-covered box with a white interior, open side up against the right wooden end panel, holding the upright white box.
nearby_obstacles: Right wooden end panel touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Right side flush with the end panel and back at the wall; about 12 cm of shelf to its left.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the green box approximately 5 cm left, away from the end panel.
Slide the green box approximately 10 cm toward the front of the shelf.

targets.other_notes: The white box inside is loose and moves with it.

source: Staged permutation of S0015 and S0017, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
